verdict.rationale: Operating a CRM through natural-language commands is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a natural-language command interface, AI assistant, or conversational control in Capsule. The cited features (bearer-token API, Zapier, Gmail/Outlook add-ins, text search of notes and emails) are conventional UI or developer building blocks, not natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
